name: paper_cc_discharge_0p5C
comment: 0.5C full discharge to 2.80V, then 30 min rest with logging still on (the relaxation tail feeds the diffusion time-constant fit), then CC-CV recharge to full at 0.5C to prep for the next C-rate file. Start from a full charge. Run this file, then 02b (1C), then 02c (2C), in sequence for the full ~1-day set.
